channel.title: Pier & Point · 235 Berry
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 235 Berry (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 235 Berry: 235 Berry now uses its Assessor lot lines.
item.description: 235 Berry now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8708111.

item.title: Correction · 235 Berry: 235 Berry's developer is given as Signature Development Group only, and the note that Avalon I is a condominium-mapped building was withdrawn because the Assessor shows a single lot at its address.

item.title: Correction · 235 Berry: 235 Berry's September 2006 sales report no longer sets an 'under construction' status the article doesn't state.
item.description: 235 Berry's September 2006 sales report no longer sets an 'under construction' status the article doesn't state. Source: https://socketsite.com/archives/2006/09/235_berry_street_update_under_50_sold.html.

item.title: Correction · 235 Berry: The map notes said 235 Berry is informally 'Signature II' to 255 Berry's 'Signature I'; no cited source uses those names, so the claim was withdrawn. The comparison with other condo-mapped towers no longer lists Avalon II and III, which are not condo-mapped. The 2007 completion milestone now cites Skybox Realty's 'Built in 2007', and the 2006 milestone cites the SocketSite post and no longer states 50% sold.
item.description: The map notes said 235 Berry is informally 'Signature II' to 255 Berry's 'Signature I'; no cited source uses those names, so the claim was withdrawn. The 2007 completion milestone now cites Skybox Realty's 'Built in 2007', and the 2006 milestone cites the SocketSite post and no longer states 50% sold. Source: Skybox Realty, 235 Berry (https://skyboxrealty.com/portfolio/235-berry/); SocketSite, 2006-09-26 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2006/09/235_berry_street_update_under_50_sold.html); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sfgov.org/Geographic-Locations-and-Boundaries/Parcels-Active-and-Retired/acdm-wktn); LMS Architects, 235 Berry Street (https://lmsarch.com/projects/235-berry-street/) (does not state this); OpenStreetMap way 46264105 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/46264105) (does not state this).
